title: F12 concrete Tauri/React shell journey correction proposal
scope: Source inventory only; ViewRight Tauri/React, RightKit desktop template, and SwiftUI/SwiftRight SliceApp boundary.

findings.title: Startup reveal, legal gate, workspace window, and print preview
findings.trigger: Tauri launches hidden window; legal receipt may be absent; print-preview query may be present.
findings.action: React mounts; pre-reveal window state is prepared; legal gate accepts or quits; print preview loads payload and invokes native print.
findings.outcome: Window reveals once; accepted workspace is maximized; print preview closes after print.

findings.title: Format router and document panes
findings.trigger: User opens supported local file or web URL.
findings.action: Route by format to web, PDF, DOCX, image, TXT, HTML, MDX, or Markdown pane; mount lazy viewer under per-document error boundary.
findings.outcome: Format-specific viewer/editor exposes its own save/find/view/print hooks.
findings.current_f12: omitted; existing media/PDF rows do not enumerate consumer routes

findings.title: Cold launch, open-file handoff, and initial paths
findings.trigger: Cold launch, argv file association, Finder open, or second-instance path.
findings.action: Register listeners before initial path drain; broker paths; open launch paths before saved session; preserve launch activation.
findings.outcome: Requested file is visible; failures stay in error banner; saved tabs follow launch tab ordering.

findings.title: Session, draft, view-state, and setup recovery
findings.trigger: Relaunch with saved tabs, untitled drafts, view metadata, or recovery snapshot.
findings.action: Load localStorage/SQLite records; regrant file tokens; restore active/background tabs; restore recovery snapshot; report missing files.
findings.outcome: Prior tabs/drafts resume without wiping initial saved session; missing files produce info toast.

findings.title: Settings modal and persistence
findings.trigger: User opens settings from app shell or native macOS menu.
findings.action: Focus-trapped modal changes section and controls; localStorage fast path hydrates SQLite mirror when empty; updates are debounced to mirror.
findings.outcome: Settings sections/values remain available across reload; Escape/backdrop closes modal.

findings.title: Native menu to renderer command bridge
findings.trigger: User selects macOS native menu item.
findings.action: Tauri menu maps `vr-key`, `vr-event`, and `vr-cmd` IDs to KeyboardEvent or window events; quit closes through dirty-save gate.
findings.outcome: Existing web shortcut/document command executes; menu state reflects active format.
findings.current_f12: native menu row lacks concrete commands

findings.title: Single instance, Finder open, and macOS reopen
findings.trigger: Second process launch, macOS Opened event, or Dock reopen with hidden window.
findings.action: Show/unminimize/focus main window; emit prepare-setup or route paths; macOS event loop handles Opened/Reopen.
findings.outcome: Existing process receives request; no duplicate main workspace is needed.

findings.title: Native drag/drop broker and React claim
findings.trigger: User drags files into Tauri window.
findings.action: Rust grants paths and emits scaled coordinates; React gives active Markdown target up to 4s to claim images, then opens remaining paths in order.
findings.outcome: Claimed images insert into active editor; unclaimed files open as tabs.

findings.title: Web URL tab, context link, and external opener
findings.trigger: Open URL, link new tab/window, native context action, or allowed external navigation.
findings.action: Normalize URL; add foreground/background web tab; record recent; route allowed `http(s)`/`mailto`; explicit browser escape uses opener.
findings.outcome: URL stays in ViewRight tab or opens in system browser per action.

findings.title: Purpose-scoped file grants and streams
findings.trigger: Open/save dialog, recent/pin selection, local linked path, HTML/MDX relative resource, or binary viewer load.
findings.action: Rust grants/regrants path token; renderer invokes typed bridge; binary formats use revocable stream/site tokens.
findings.outcome: Only user-selected or already-authorized paths open; revoked/invalid grants fail cleanly.

findings.title: External file change and dirty conflict
findings.trigger: Open file or HTML subpage changes outside ViewRight.
findings.action: Re-arm one watcher over all open/subpage paths; reload clean tab or enter dirty conflict decision flow.
findings.outcome: Clean content refreshes; dirty edits remain protected until user chooses reload/keep.

findings.title: Update check, license eligibility, install, relaunch, and recovery
findings.trigger: Manual or enabled automatic update check; signed release available; install fails.
findings.action: Check updater; map tier/license state; install and relaunch; retry or open public installer after failure.
findings.outcome: UI reports current/available/license-required/failed/installing states; successful install relaunches.
findings.current_f12: update row lacks license/auto-check/install recovery detail

findings.title: SliceApp single SwiftUI/SwiftRight editor root
findings.trigger: SliceApp starts on macOS or Windows.
findings.action: Create one `Window("SliceApp", id: "main")`; editor inserts, edits, moves, nudges, or deletes rows; model persists each mutation.
findings.outcome: Rows render and reload from RowStore; no Tauri/React route exists.
